# FAQ

## Experience

André has more than twenty years of backend experience, mostly building platforms for companies in the
United States. He works with Python, REST APIs and event-driven systems on AWS.

## Cloud

On AWS he has used Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Kinesis, SQS and S3 to build serverless pipelines that
process millions of events per day.

## Availability

He works remotely and overlaps with United States and European business hours.
